form.label: CVE impact overview
form.description: New Rapid7 checks (by date added) and how many of your Active servers they affect, by Prod (DC / DR) and Non-prod (UAT / SIT / DEV). Sources: rapid7:vm:vuln_content, rapid7:vm:asset_vuln, rapid7:vm:asset_site and your CMDB lookups.

search.query: `r7_index` sourcetype="rapid7:vm:vuln_content" earliest=-8d | dedup vuln_id | eval added_e=strptime(substr(added,1,10),"%Y-%m-%d") | where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-7d@d") | rename cves{} as cve | search $sev$ | fields vuln_id cve title severity cvss_v3 published added modified added_e

`r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_vuln)` [search `r7_index` sourcetype="rapid7:vm:vuln_content" earliest=-8d | dedup vuln_id | eval added_e=strptime(substr(added,1,10),"%Y-%m-%d") | where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-7d@d") | fields vuln_id | rename vuln_id as search | format] | rename vuln_ids{} as vuln_id | fields asset_id hostname ip vuln_id | mvexpand vuln_id | join type=inner vuln_id [search `r7_index` sourcetype="rapid7:vm:vuln_content" earliest=-8d | dedup vuln_id | eval added_e=strptime(substr(added,1,10),"%Y-%m-%d") | where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-7d@d") | rename cves{} as cve | table vuln_id cve title severity cvss_v3] | `r7_cmdb_enrich` | where cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" | search env_label="$env$" $sev$ | fields asset_id hostname ip vuln_id cve severity env_label env_group appname
| where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-1d@d") | mvexpand cve | stats dc(cve) as cves
| mvexpand cve | stats dc(cve) as cves

single.title: New CVEs affecting your servers (7 d)

search.query: | where env_group="Prod" | stats dc(asset_id) as servers
| where env_group="Non-prod" | stats dc(asset_id) as servers
`r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` | dedup asset_id | stats count(eval(credentialed="true")) as with_sw count as total | eval coverage=round(with_sw/total*100,1) | fields coverage

table.title: New CVEs in Rapid7 (added in the last 7 days) and your affected servers

search.query: `r7_index` sourcetype="rapid7:vm:vuln_content" earliest=-8d | dedup vuln_id | eval added_e=strptime(substr(added,1,10),"%Y-%m-%d") | where added_e>=relative_time(now(),"-7d@d") | rename cves{} as cve | search $sev$ | mvexpand cve | stats values(vuln_id) as rapid7_checks first(title) as title first(severity) as severity max(cvss_v3) as cvss_v3 min(published) as published min(added) as added max(modified) as modified by cve | join type=left cve [search `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_vuln)` | rename vuln_ids{} as vuln_id | fields asset_id hostname ip vuln_id | mvexpand vuln_id | join type=inner vuln_id [search `r7_index` sourcetype="rapid7:vm:vuln_content" earliest=-8d | dedup vuln_id | rename cves{} as cve | table vuln_id cve] | `r7_cmdb_enrich` | where cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" | search env_label="$env$" | mvexpand cve | stats dc(asset_id) as your_servers dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DC",asset_id,null()))) as prod_dc dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DR",asset_id,null()))) as prod_dr dc(eval(if(env_group="Non-prod",asset_id,null()))) as non_prod by cve] | fillnull value=0 your_servers prod_dc prod_dr non_prod | sort - prod_dc - prod_dr - cvss_v3 | table cve rapid7_checks title severity cvss_v3 published added modified your_servers prod_dc prod_dr non_prod | rename prod_dc as "Prod · DC" prod_dr as "Prod · DR" non_prod as "Non-prod"

table.title: Software inventory coverage by environment (servers with software data = credentialed scan or Insight Agent)

search.query: `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` | dedup asset_id | `r7_cmdb_enrich` | where cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" OR cmdb_status="NOT_IN_CMDB" | stats count as servers count(eval(credentialed="true")) as with_software_data by env_label | eval without=servers-with_software_data, coverage_pct=round(with_software_data/servers*100,1) | eval sort_order=case(env_label="Prod · DC",1, env_label="Prod · DR",2, like(env_label,"Non-prod%"),3, true(),4) | sort sort_order env_label | fields - sort_order
